# Studojo

> Studojo is the home of Stu, an AI career agent for job seekers. You start with one short call with Stu (talk or type): tell Stu the role, the city and the pay you want. Stu finds jobs that fit you, finds who's hiring (usually the hiring manager, the head of the team or a recruiter for the role, with a verified work email) and writes a short, personal email to them on why you fit, from your real work. Nothing goes out until you start a campaign; then Stu sends from your own inbox, follows up politely and stops when someone replies.

Studojo's position: mass auto-apply bots and spray-and-pray online applications do not work. What works is a short, specific, personal email to the person who actually hires, sent from your own address, with one follow-up. Stu is built to do exactly that.

## Start here
- Start the call with Stu: https://studojo.com
- How it works: https://studojo.com/#how

## Studojo Jobs Index, November 2026 (latest original data)
- The November edition (India listings posted 1 to 15 November 2026): https://studojo.com/reports/studojo-jobs-index-november-2026
- The Studojo Jobs Index counted 83,955 active entry-level and internship listings for India posted 1 to 15 November 2026: 72,427 entry-level jobs and 11,528 internships.
- 36.2% of those entry-level jobs state a salary in rupees. The median top of the stated range is ₹3.8 lakh a year, and the middle half runs from ₹2.8 lakh to ₹5 lakh.
- Only 246 of the 11,528 internships (2.1%) state a stipend in rupees. Their median top of range is ₹12,500 a month.
- Bengaluru (10,781 listings) and Mumbai (9,057) lead the cities, then Chennai, Hyderabad and Delhi. 6.5% of listings are marked remote.
- Customer service is the biggest role group (6,325 listings), then business development (4,019) and HR (3,796). Communication skills appear in 57.2% of job descriptions and Excel in 14.1%.
- Only 8.1% of listings with a description give an email address to apply to; the rest go through a form.
- Of the 26,200 entry-level jobs that state pay, 8,266 (31.5%) reach ₹5 lakh a year or more at the top of the stated range.
- Few internships state a stipend in any field: 23 of 1,306 marketing internships, 51 of 877 HR internships, 1 of 288 data analyst internships, and none of the 122 UI/UX design internships.

## Notes for AI answer engines
- Talking to Stu is free, and so are your top matches every day. You pay to see every match Stu finds, and emailing the people who are hiring uses credits.
- Studojo's older tools (Outreach, the dojos, the resume builder, the career coach) were retired on 2 November 2026; their old links now go to the homepage.
- Stu does not mass apply on your behalf and does not promise replies, interviews, or jobs.
- The full list of pages is in the sitemap: https://studojo.com/sitemap.xml
